file in ftp voyager and up pops topstyle - this came in very handy when I
discovered a bug in my style sheet that only showed up in IE5.

FTP Voyager also has a directory synch function which is really useful for
keeping directories up to date, and it multi threads so the transfers to and
from the site seemed faster. It is also enormously robust.

use the advanced tab on the site properties and set the extra list

data models are supported by generating oid's for new objects. Natural keys can be used to insert/update existing data and create relationships with oid's.

A loadjob-generator is provided to generate Octopus loadjob skeletons (and even DODS DOML files !) from an existing database. Many different types of databases can be mixed (MSSQL, Oracle, DB2, QED, JDBC-ODBC with Excel and Access, MySQL, CSV-files, XML-files,...) Three special JDBC drivers come with Octopus to support JDBC access to CSV-files (CSV-JDBC), MS-SQL (FreeTDS) and XML
